name: deployments-01
description: The latest builds, each with its commit, environment, author, duration and status.

files.content:
'use client' import { BlockReady, BlockStateProvider, BlockStateRows, type BlockStateProps, getBlockState, } from '@/registry/components/dashboardblocks/block-state' import { type DeployStatus, DeployStatusLabel, deployStatusConfig, formatDuration, shortSha, } from '@/registry/components/dashboardblocks/deployments' import { Details } from '@/registry/components/dashboardblocks/details' import { PersonAvatar } from '@/registry/components/dashboardblocks/team' import { formatRelativeTime } from '@/registry/lib/dashboardblocks/format' interface Deployment { author: string authorAvatar?: string /** Seconds the build and deploy took, or have taken so far. */ duration: number environment: string id: string message: string sha: string startedAt: Date status: DeployStatus } interface Deployments1Props extends BlockStateProps { /** Leave out, or pass none, to show the empty state. */ deployments?: Deployment[] /** Defaults to a sentence counting the deploys and any that need a look. */ description?: string /** Pass a fixed date, so the block renders the same on the server and in the browser. */ now: Date title: string } const NOW = new Date(Date.UTC(2026, 8, 26, 15, 0)) const minutesAgo = (minutes: number) => new Date(NOW.getTime() - minutes * 60_000) const exampleProps: Deployments1Props = { deployments: [ { author: 'Ana Lima', authorAvatar: '/images/avatar-01.webp', duration: 94, environment: 'Production', id: 'd1', message: 'Fix currency rounding on invoices', sha: '9f3c2a17b', startedAt: minutesAgo(2), status: 'running', }, { author: 'Ana Lima', authorAvatar: '/images/avatar-01.webp', duration: 212, environment: 'Preview', id: 'd2', message: 'Fix currency rounding on invoices', sha: '9f3c2a17b', startedAt: minutesAgo(14), status: 'success', }, { author: 'Kenji Mori', authorAvatar: '/images/avatar-04.webp', duration: 187, environment: 'Production', id: 'd3', message: 'Add retry to webhook delivery', sha: '41be08d3c', startedAt: minutesAgo(52), status: 'success', }, { author: 'Sara Okafor', authorAvatar: '/images/avatar-05.webp', duration: 66, environment: 'Production', id: 'd4', message: 'Upgrade image pipeline', sha: 'c07d9e412', startedAt: minutesAgo(130), status: 'rolled-back', }, { author: 'Sara Okafor', authorAvatar: '/images/avatar-05.webp', duration: 143, environment: 'Preview', id: 'd5', message: 'Upgrade image pipeline', sha: 'c07d9e412', startedAt: minutesAgo(155), status: 'failed', }, ], now: NOW, title: 'Deployments', } const summarize = (deployments: Deployment[], now: Date) => { if (deployments.length === 0) return 'Nothing deployed yet.' const oldest = Math.min( ...deployments.map((deployment) => deployment.startedAt.getTime()), ) const hours = Math.max(1, Math.ceil((now.getTime() - oldest) / 3_600_000)) const span = hours <= 48 ? `${hours} ${hours === 1 ? 'hour' : 'hours'}` : `${Math.ceil(hours / 24)} days` const count = `${deployments.length} ${deployments.length === 1 ? 'deploy' : 'deploys'} in the last ${span}.` const notable = (['running', 'failed', 'rolled-back'] as const) .map((status) => { const matching = deployments.filter( (deployment) => deployment.status === status, ).length return matching > 0 ? `${matching} ${deployStatusConfig[status].label.toLowerCase()}` : null }) .filter(Boolean) return notable.length > 0 ? `${count} ${notable.join(', ')}.` : `${count} All ready.` } const Deployments1 = (props: Deployments1Props) => { const { deployments = [], now, errorMessage, status, title } = props const { description = summarize(deployments, now) } = props return (

{title}

{description}
    {!status && deployments.map((deployment) => (
  • {deployment.message}

    {deployment.environment}

    {shortSha(deployment.sha)} {deployment.author} {formatRelativeTime(deployment.startedAt, now)}

    {deployment.status === 'running' ? 'Building for ' : 'Took '} {formatDuration(deployment.duration)}
    • ))}
) } export { Deployments1, exampleProps as deployments1ExampleProps, type Deployment, type Deployments1Props, }
